blocks.text: Twenty minutes into the call I heard a turn signal. Then a cough that

wasn't Mara's.

She never said he was in the car. She let me talk about the budget thing,
about Mom, about whether I'm going to Jess's wedding — she *let me* — and
he was sitting right there the whole time. When I said "is someone with
you" she said "oh, yeah" like I'd asked about the weather.
I keep trying to find the version where she wasn't doing something to me.
I get close and then I hear the turn signal again.
